No compilation errors. All changes complete:

- **Abstract**: Rewritten with new narrative (clause wording dominates risk, type predicts mechanism 30x better than violation rate, partial ordering framing)
- **§1 paragraph 4**: Updated from "type determines severity" to "clause wording drives risk, taxonomy predicts mechanisms"
- **§1 contribution (2)**: Replaced with variance decomposition + MI analysis, repositioning taxonomy as intervention-design framework
- **§5.1**: "OR" → "conditional OR"
- **§5.2**: Removed observed power statistic; replaced all "risk gradient" with "partial ordering"; updated subsection title, section intro, and figure caption; added "evaluation-dependent" qualifier
- **§8 Conclusion**: Rewritten with conditional OR, domain qualifier, mechanism-prediction framing, and type-targeted mitigation language
